correctness.rationale: Logit coordinates m=(u+v)/2, d=(u-v)/2 give the exact tanh recurrence, transverse increase d>0 and Taylor m’=-m+m³/6+md²/2+O(|m|(m²+d²)²), d’/d=3−m²/2−d²/6+O((m²+d²)²). In a fixed small exit tube d grows by factors bounded between 2 and 4, so sum(d_j²) is uniformly bounded. w_j=m_j^-2 has increments 1/3+w_j d_j²+controlled terms; discrete Gronwall bounds w_j ~ j and yields uniform sum(m_j²)=3log N+O(1) by summing weighted perturbations. Then sum log(d_{j+1}/d_j)=Nlog3-(1/6)sum(m_j²)+O(1)=Nlog3-(1/2)logN+O(1), giving the sharp two-term clock. Nonexceptional diagonal starts reach the small tube after a fixed transient with positive transverse derivative; center m=0 is invariant and gives only main log clock. Exceptional backward-orbit starts other than z=1/2 are expressly excluded, and fixed thresholds are essential.

value.rationale: Nonhyperbolic bifurcation produces a divergent loglog correction to a finite-time separation observable. It fills a sharp gap between known scalar critical relaxation and the hyperbolic a>8 escape theorem and requires nonlinear pre-exit uniform estimates, not just differentiating the diagonal map.

final_claim: At the neutral threshold a=8 of the symmetric two-player multiplicative-weights map, for each nonexceptional diagonal start z and sufficiently small fixed log-odds exit threshold, the near-diagonal first separation time is log(1/epsilon)/log 3 + loglog(1/epsilon)/(2 log 3)+O_{z,delta}(1); for the central start z=1/2 the logarithmic-logarithmic term vanishes. Same leading statements hold for sufficiently small physical exit thresholds.
limitations: Fixed gain 8, exactly symmetric payoffs, z outside backward orbit of center, fixed small first-exit thresholds; no post-exit global-time or all-exceptional-start classification.
